environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on EC2 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). PostgreSQL 14 direct connection (no connection pooler). pg driver version 8.7.3 with default settings. No query analysis or SQL firewall. The sort parameter injection allows ORDER BY clause manipulation including CASE-based blind injection and stacked queries via semicolons. The use-after-free on the connection allows cross-tenant data leakage when the pool reassigns the underlying TCP socket to a different authenticated session.
